source_read: https://www.blankstreet.com/en-GB/BlankStreetUKAllergenGuideAutumn26.pdf (downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; robots.txt answers 404 = no restrictions; byte-identical to the copy the script used, sha256 cde3b86a...)
not_verifiable: Allergens are link-only (no allergens.csv): the guide gives two ingredient lists per drink (dairy and oat) for one kcal figure, so there is no per-item allergen table to compare.
notes: Calories-only chain. My own left-column pdftotext parse of all 127 printed products matched all 178 published items: every printed figure appears exactly once as an item, and the hot / iced / small / large / hot-or-iced pairing is right (only difference: names that already carry HOT/Iced). Pages 1, 6, 9, 11, 12, 13, 16 and 18 rendered and read by eye (drinks, house lattes, signature ice cream, Manchester / Birmingham / Cambridge / Brighton pastries). Vegetarian tags: every 'May Contain' block in the guide is followed by Vegetarian or Vegan, so tagging all 178 is consistent. Things to know, all as printed: Iced Blondie Latte prints 'S - 207 | L - 227' with no kcal unit (read as kcal, noted on the item); 'Plan Croissant' (Manchester) is a typo for Plain Croissant (noted on the item); the same pastry has very different figures by city (Almond Croissant 382 kcal Manchester, 420 London, 998 Cambridge) because the guide lists a different recipe per city. The audit raised no flags.
